title: CLIPort: What and Where Pathways for Robotic Manipulation
summary: How can we imbue robots with the ability to manipulate objects precisely but also to reason about them in terms of abstract concepts? Recent works in manipulation have shown that end-to-end networks can learn dexterous skills that require precise spatial reasoning, but these methods often fail to generalize to new goals or quickly learn transferable concepts across tasks. In parallel, there has been great progress in learning generalizable semantic representations for vision and language by training on large-scale internet data, however these representations lack the spatial understanding necessary for fine-grained manipulation. To this end, we propose a framework that combines the best of both worlds: a two-stream architecture with semantic and spatial pathways for vision-based manipulation. Specifically, we present CLIPort, a language-conditioned imitation-learning agent that combines the broad semantic understanding (what) of CLIP [1] with the spatial precision (where) of Transporter [2]. Our end-to-end framework is capable of solving a variety of language-specified tabletop tasks from packing unseen objects to folding cloths, all without any explicit representations of object poses, instance segmentations, memory, symbolic states, or syntactic structures. Experiments in simulated and real-world settings show that our approach is data efficient in few-shot settings and generalizes effectively to seen and unseen semantic concepts. We even learn one multi-task policy for 10 simulated and 9 real-world tasks that is better or comparable to single-task policies.

AI.tldr: 提出了CLIPort，一个结合CLIP语义理解与Transporter空间精度的双流语言条件模仿学习框架，用于视觉操作任务，在模拟和真实世界实验中实现高效的少样本学习和跨任务泛化。
AI.motivation: 端到端操作网络虽然能学习需要精细空间推理的灵巧技能，但难以泛化到新目标或快速学习跨任务的迁移概念；而大规模互联网数据训练的视觉语言语义表示缺乏精细操作所需的空间理解。两者优缺点互补，需要将二者结合。
AI.method: 提出双流架构CLIPort，包含语义通路（使用CLIP提供广泛的语义理解"what"）和空间通路（使用Transporter提供空间精度"where"），通过语言条件模仿学习，端到端联合训练，无需显式的物体姿态、实例分割、记忆、符号状态或语法结构表示。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实世界实验中，CLIPort在少样本设置下数据高效，能有效泛化到已见和未见的语义概念，并可学习一个多任务策略（10个模拟任务和9个真实任务），其性能优于或与单任务策略相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语义理解与空间推理结合的双流架构，CLIPort证明了语言条件操作智能体既能保持精细操作的空间精度，又能获得语义级别的泛化能力，为机器人操控任务提供了兼顾精度与抽象推理能力的有效方案。

title: BC-Z: Zero-Shot Task Generalization with Robotic Imitation Learning
summary: In this paper, we study the problem of enabling a vision-based robotic manipulation system to generalize to novel tasks, a long-standing challenge in robot learning. We approach the challenge from an imitation learning perspective, aiming to study how scaling and broadening the data collected can facilitate such generalization. To that end, we develop an interactive and flexible imitation learning system that can learn from both demonstrations and interventions and can be conditioned on different forms of information that convey the task, including pre-trained embeddings of natural language or videos of humans performing the task. When scaling data collection on a real robot to more than 100 distinct tasks, we find that this system can perform 24 unseen manipulation tasks with an average success rate of 44%, without any robot demonstrations for those tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何使基于视觉的机器人操纵系统泛化到新任务，从模仿学习视角出发，开发了一个可从演示和干预中学习、可通过预训练自然语言嵌入或人类任务视频进行条件控制的交互式灵活模仿学习系统。该系统在真实机器人上扩展到100多个不同任务的数据后，无需任何机器人演示即可在24个未见过的操纵任务上实现44%的平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 实现视觉机器人操纵系统对新任务的泛化能力是机器人学习领域的长期挑战。作者希望从模仿学习的角度出发，探索如何通过扩展和拓宽数据收集范围来促进这种泛化能力。
AI.method: 开发了一个交互式且灵活的模仿学习系统，具备两个关键能力：1) 能够同时从演示和干预中学习；2) 可基于多种任务信息形式进行条件控制，包括预训练的自然语言嵌入或人类执行任务的视频。
AI.result: 在真实机器人上收集超过100个不同任务的数据后，该系统能够在24个未见过的操纵任务上实现44%的平均成功率，且无需任何针对这些任务的机器人演示。
AI.conclusion: 通过扩大和多样化训练数据，基于模仿学习的系统能够实现对全新操纵任务的零样本泛化，表明数据规模与多样性是提升机器人泛化能力的关键因素。

title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
summary: Large language models can encode a wealth of semantic knowledge about the world. Such knowledge could be extremely useful to robots aiming to act upon high-level, temporally extended instructions expressed in natural language. However, a significant weakness of language models is that they lack real-world experience, which makes it difficult to leverage them for decision making within a given embodiment. For example, asking a language model to describe how to clean a spill might result in a reasonable narrative, but it may not be applicable to a particular agent, such as a robot, that needs to perform this task in a particular environment. We propose to provide real-world grounding by means of pretrained skills, which are used to constrain the model to propose natural language actions that are both feasible and contextually appropriate. The robot can act as the language model's "hands and eyes," while the language model supplies high-level semantic knowledge about the task. We show how low-level skills can be combined with large language models so that the language model provides high-level knowledge about the procedures for performing complex and temporally-extended instructions, while value functions associated with these skills provide the grounding necessary to connect this knowledge to a particular physical environment. We evaluate our method on a number of real-world robotic tasks, where we show the need for real-world grounding and that this approach is capable of completing long-horizon, abstract, natural language instructions on a mobile manipulator. The project's website and the video can be found at https://say-can.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SayCan方法，通过预训练技能将大语言模型的知识与现实世界相连接，使机器人能够执行高层级、长期的自然语言指令。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型蕴含丰富的世界语义知识，可用于机器人执行自然语言指令，但它们缺乏真实世界经验，无法将知识适配到特定机器人实体和特定环境中。例如，让语言模型描述如何清理溢出的液体可能会给出合理的叙述，但不一定适用于特定机器人在特定环境中执行。
AI.method: 提出用预训练技能提供真实世界基础（grounding），约束语言模型提出既可行又上下文恰当的自然语言动作。机器人充当语言模型的"手和眼睛"，语言模型提供任务的高层语义知识。低层技能与语言模型结合：语言模型提供复杂、时间延展指令的程序性高层知识，与技能相关的值函数（value functions）提供将知识连接到特定物理环境的grounding。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界机器人任务上评估了该方法，展示了真实世界grounding的必要性，并证明该方法能够在移动操作机器人上完成长时域、抽象的自然语言指令。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了通过技能值函数实现grounding的方法可以有效弥补语言模型缺乏真实世界经验的短板，使语言模型的高层语义知识能够切实应用于机器人的长期任务执行。

title: A Generalist Agent
summary: Inspired by progress in large-scale language modeling, we apply a similar approach towards building a single generalist agent beyond the realm of text outputs. The agent, which we refer to as Gato, works as a multi-modal, multi-task, multi-embodiment generalist policy. The same network with the same weights can play Atari, caption images, chat, stack blocks with a real robot arm and much more, deciding based on its context whether to output text, joint torques, button presses, or other tokens. In this report we describe the model and the data, and document the current capabilities of Gato.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gato，一个受大规模语言建模启发而构建的多模态、多任务、多形态通用智能体策略，同一网络权重可以执行玩Atari游戏、图像字幕、聊天、控制真实机械臂堆叠积木等多种任务。
AI.motivation: 受到大规模语言建模成功的启发，研究者希望将类似的方法推广到文本之外，构建一个超越单一任务/单一形态限制的通用型智能体。
AI.method: 将智能体设计为多模态、多任务、多形态的通用策略网络Gato，统一在同一网络和同一权重下，通过上下文决定输出文本、关节力矩、按键或其他token。
AI.result: Gato能够在一个单一的通用策略中同时完成多种不同模态和领域下的任务，包括游戏、视觉语言任务、对话以及真实机器人控制等。
AI.conclusion: 该工作报告了模型架构、数据以及Gato的当前能力水平，表明通用智能体可以通过类似大规模语言建模的范式实现。

title: Perceiver-Actor: A Multi-Task Transformer for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Transformers have revolutionized vision and natural language processing with their ability to scale with large datasets. But in robotic manipulation, data is both limited and expensive. Can manipulation still benefit from Transformers with the right problem formulation? We investigate this question with PerAct, a language-conditioned behavior-cloning agent for multi-task 6-DoF manipulation. PerAct encodes language goals and RGB-D voxel observations with a Perceiver Transformer, and outputs discretized actions by ``detecting the next best voxel action''. Unlike frameworks that operate on 2D images, the voxelized 3D observation and action space provides a strong structural prior for efficiently learning 6-DoF actions. With this formulation, we train a single multi-task Transformer for 18 RLBench tasks (with 249 variations) and 7 real-world tasks (with 18 variations) from just a few demonstrations per task. Our results show that PerAct significantly outperforms unstructured image-to-action agents and 3D ConvNet baselines for a wide range of tabletop tasks.

AI.tldr: PerAct是一个基于Perceiver Transformer的语言条件行为克隆智能体，用于多任务6自由度机器人操作。通过将RGB-D观测体素化，将动作输出建模为"检测下一个最佳体素动作"的分类问题，仅需少量演示即可在18个RLBench任务（249个变体）和7个真实世界任务（18个变体）上显著优于图像到动作的基线方法和3D ConvNet基线。
AI.motivation: 视觉和NLP领域中的Transformer凭借大规模数据实现了规模化优势，但在机器人操作领域，数据既有限又昂贵。作者希望探究：在正确的问题公式化下，Transformer能否在数据稀缺的机器人操作任务中仍然受益。
AI.method: PerAct以Perceiver Transformer为核心架构，将语言目标和RGB-D体素观测作为输入，输出离散化动作——通过"检测下一个最佳体素动作"的方式。与基于2D图像的框架不同，体素化的3D观测和动作空间为高效学习6-DoF动作提供了强结构先验。单个多任务Transformer被训练来处理18个RLBench任务和7个真实世界任务，每个任务仅需少量演示。
AI.result: PerAct在广泛的桌面任务中显著优于非结构化的图像-到-动作智能体和3D ConvNet基线，验证了体素化3D观测与动作空间的强结构先验在低数据条件下对Transformer学习的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，即使在数据稀缺的机器人操作领域，通过恰当的问题形式化（体素化3D空间+语言条件），Transformer依然能够发挥其能力，实现多任务6-DoF操作的高效学习。

title: RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale
summary: By transferring knowledge from large, diverse, task-agnostic datasets, modern machine learning models can solve specific downstream tasks either zero-shot or with small task-specific datasets to a high level of performance. While this capability has been demonstrated in other fields such as computer vision, natural language processing or speech recognition, it remains to be shown in robotics, where the generalization capabilities of the models are particularly critical due to the difficulty of collecting real-world robotic data. We argue that one of the keys to the success of such general robotic models lies with open-ended task-agnostic training, combined with high-capacity architectures that can absorb all of the diverse, robotic data. In this paper, we present a model class, dubbed Robotics Transformer, that exhibits promising scalable model properties. We verify our conclusions in a study of different model classes and their ability to generalize as a function of the data size, model size, and data diversity based on a large-scale data collection on real robots performing real-world tasks. The project's website and videos can be found at robotics-transformer1.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出Robotics Transformer（RT-1），一种机器人策略模型，通过在真实机器人上大规模收集多样化任务无关数据，并结合高容量架构进行训练，展示了机器人领域中模型规模、数据规模和多样性对泛化能力的可扩展性影响。
AI.motivation: 虽然在计算机视觉、NLP和语音识别等领域，大规模任务无关数据预训练已展现出强大的零样本或小样本迁移能力，但这一能力在机器人领域尚未得到验证。由于真实机器人数据采集困难，模型的泛化能力尤为关键，因此需要探索一种能够在机器人场景下实现跨任务泛化的通用模型范式。
AI.method: 提出Robotics Transformer（RT-1）模型类，其核心在于：(1) 采用开放式的任务无关训练策略，从大规模、多样化的真实机器人数据中学习；(2) 使用高容量架构以吸收多样化的机器人数据；(3) 通过对不同模型类在数据规模、模型规模和任务多样性维度上的系统研究来验证其可扩展性。研究基于真实机器人执行真实世界任务的大规模数据收集。
AI.result: 实验表明RT-1在可扩展性方面表现优异，随着数据规模、模型容量和任务多样性的增加，模型的泛化能力得到系统性提升，验证了任务无关训练结合高容量架构在机器人学习中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 开放式的任务无关训练和高容量架构是构建通用机器人模型的关键要素，RT-1展示了在真实机器人数据上实现可扩展泛化的潜力，为通用机器人基础模型的建立提供了可行性论证和初步解决方案。

title: PaLM-E: An Embodied Multimodal Language Model
summary: Large language models excel at a wide range of complex tasks. However, enabling general inference in the real world, e.g., for robotics problems, raises the challenge of grounding. We propose embodied language models to directly incorporate real-world continuous sensor modalities into language models and thereby establish the link between words and percepts. Input to our embodied language model are multi-modal sentences that interleave visual, continuous state estimation, and textual input encodings. We train these encodings end-to-end, in conjunction with a pre-trained large language model, for multiple embodied tasks including sequential robotic manipulation planning, visual question answering, and captioning. Our evaluations show that PaLM-E, a single large embodied multimodal model, can address a variety of embodied reasoning tasks, from a variety of observation modalities, on multiple embodiments, and further, exhibits positive transfer: the model benefits from diverse joint training across internet-scale language, vision, and visual-language domains. Our largest model, PaLM-E-562B with 562B parameters, in addition to being trained on robotics tasks, is a visual-language generalist with state-of-the-art performance on OK-VQA, and retains generalist language capabilities with increasing scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PaLM-E，一种嵌入具身语言模型，将真实世界连续感知模态（视觉、状态估计）直接整合进大型语言模型，通过多模态句子实现语言与感知的关联，在机器人操作规划、视觉问答和图像描述等任务上表现出色，其最大模型PaLM-E-562B（5620亿参数）在OK-VQA上达到SOTA性能，并保持了语言通用能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在广泛复杂任务上表现出色，但要在真实世界中进行通用推理（如机器人问题）面临接地（grounding）挑战，即如何将语言与真实世界的连续感知信号关联起来。
AI.method: 提出嵌入具身语言模型（embodied language model），其输入为多模态句子，将视觉、连续状态估计和文本输入编码交错组合。这些编码与预训练大型语言模型进行端到端联合训练，覆盖顺序机器人操作规划、视觉问答和图像描述等多个具身任务。
AI.result: PaLM-E作为单一大型具身多模态模型，能处理多种观察模态和多种具身形态下的各类具身推理任务，并展现出正向迁移能力——受益于跨互联网规模语言、视觉和视觉-语言领域的多样联合训练。PaLM-E-562B（5620亿参数）在OK-VQA上达到视觉-语言通才的SOTA性能，并随规模增大保持通用语言能力。
AI.conclusion: 单一大型具身多模态模型能够统一处理多种具身推理任务，并展示正向迁移效应；规模越大，模型不仅提升具身任务能力，还保持并增强视觉-语言通用性，表明具身训练与语言/视觉表征可以协同发展。

title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
summary: This paper introduces Diffusion Policy, a new way of generating robot behavior by representing a robot's visuomotor policy as a conditional denoising diffusion process. We benchmark Diffusion Policy across 12 different tasks from 4 different robot manipulation benchmarks and find that it consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art robot learning methods with an average improvement of 46.9%. Diffusion Policy learns the gradient of the action-distribution score function and iteratively optimizes with respect to this gradient field during inference via a series of stochastic Langevin dynamics steps. We find that the diffusion formulation yields powerful advantages when used for robot policies, including gracefully handling multimodal action distributions, being suitable for high-dimensional action spaces, and exhibiting impressive training stability. To fully unlock the potential of diffusion models for visuomotor policy learning on physical robots, this paper presents a set of key technical contributions including the incorporation of receding horizon control, visual conditioning, and the time-series diffusion transformer. We hope this work will help motivate a new generation of policy learning techniques that are able to leverage the powerful generative modeling capabilities of diffusion models. Code, data, and training details is publicly available diffusion-policy.cs.columbia.edu

AI.tldr: 本文提出Diffusion Policy，一种将机器人视触觉策略表示为条件去噪扩散过程的新方法，在12个任务、4个基准上平均提升46.9%，超越现有最先进方法，并通过引入滚动时域控制、视觉条件化和时间序列扩散Transformer等关键技术释放扩散模型在机器人策略学习中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人学习方法在处理多模态动作分布、高维动作空间和训练稳定性方面存在局限，作者希望利用扩散模型的强大生成能力来应对这些挑战，从而提出一种新的机器人行为生成范式。
AI.method: 将机器人视触觉策略建模为条件去噪扩散过程，学习动作分布的得分函数梯度，并在推理阶段通过随机Langevin动力学步骤进行迭代优化。同时引入三项关键技术：滚动时域控制（receding horizon control）、视觉条件化、以及时间序列扩散Transformer。
AI.result: 在12个不同任务和4个机器人操作基准上进行了基准测试，相比现有最先进的机器人学习方法平均提升46.9%，并展现出对多模态动作分布的优雅处理、对高维动作空间的适应性以及出色的训练稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 扩散公式为机器人策略带来了强大的优势，包括多模态处理、高维支持和训练稳定性。作者希望这项工作能激励新一代利用扩散模型生成能力的策略学习方法。

title: EmbodiedGPT: Vision-Language Pre-Training via Embodied Chain of Thought
summary: Embodied AI is a crucial frontier in robotics, capable of planning and executing action sequences for robots to accomplish long-horizon tasks in physical environments. In this work, we introduce EmbodiedGPT, an end-to-end multi-modal foundation model for embodied AI, empowering embodied agents with multi-modal understanding and execution capabilities. To achieve this, we have made the following efforts: (i) We craft a large-scale embodied planning dataset, termed EgoCOT. The dataset consists of carefully selected videos from the Ego4D dataset, along with corresponding high-quality language instructions. Specifically, we generate a sequence of sub-goals with the "Chain of Thoughts" mode for effective embodied planning. (ii) We introduce an efficient training approach to EmbodiedGPT for high-quality plan generation, by adapting a 7B large language model (LLM) to the EgoCOT dataset via prefix tuning. (iii) We introduce a paradigm for extracting task-related features from LLM-generated planning queries to form a closed loop between high-level planning and low-level control. Extensive experiments show the effectiveness of EmbodiedGPT on embodied tasks, including embodied planning, embodied control, visual captioning, and visual question answering. Notably, EmbodiedGPT significantly enhances the success rate of the embodied control task by extracting more effective features. It has achieved a remarkable 1.6 times increase in success rate on the Franka Kitchen benchmark and a 1.3 times increase on the Meta-World benchmark, compared to the BLIP-2 baseline fine-tuned with the Ego4D dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EmbodiedGPT，一个端到端的多模态具身智能基础模型，通过构建大规模具身规划数据集EgoCOT、采用前缀微调适配7B大语言模型，并建立高层规划与低层控制之间的闭环，显著提升具身智能体在规划、控制、视觉描述和视觉问答等任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 具身智能是机器人领域的关键前沿，需要机器人在物理环境中完成长时程任务。然而，现有方法缺乏统一的多模态理解和执行能力，且缺少高质量的大规模具身规划数据集，导致具身智能体在规划和控制之间的有效衔接存在瓶颈。
AI.method: (i) 构建大规模具身规划数据集EgoCOT，从Ego4D数据集中精选视频并生成高质量语言指令，以"思维链"模式生成子目标序列实现有效规划；(ii) 通过前缀微调（prefix tuning）将7B大语言模型适配到EgoCOT数据集，实现高效的规划生成；(iii) 提出从LLM生成的规划查询中提取任务相关特征的范式，在高层规划与低层控制之间形成闭环。
AI.result: 在具身规划、具身控制、视觉描述和视觉问答等具身任务上表现出有效性。在Franka Kitchen基准上成功率达到BLIP-2基线的1.6倍，在Meta-World基准上达到1.3倍，通过提取更有效的特征显著提升具身控制任务的成功率。
AI.conclusion: EmbodiedGPT展示了端到端多模态基础模型在具身智能中的潜力，通过高质量规划数据集和高效训练策略实现高层规划与低层控制的闭环协调，为具身智能体的多模态理解与执行能力提供了有效方案。

title: RoboCat: A Self-Improving Generalist Agent for Robotic Manipulation
summary: The ability to leverage heterogeneous robotic experience from different robots and tasks to quickly master novel skills and embodiments has the potential to transform robot learning. Inspired by recent advances in foundation models for vision and language, we propose a multi-embodiment, multi-task generalist agent for robotic manipulation. This agent, named RoboCat, is a visual goal-conditioned decision transformer capable of consuming action-labelled visual experience. This data spans a large repertoire of motor control skills from simulated and real robotic arms with varying sets of observations and actions. With RoboCat, we demonstrate the ability to generalise to new tasks and robots, both zero-shot as well as through adaptation using only 100-1000 examples for the target task. We also show how a trained model itself can be used to generate data for subsequent training iterations, thus providing a basic building block for an autonomous improvement loop. We investigate the agent's capabilities, with large-scale evaluations both in simulation and on three different real robot embodiments. We find that as we grow and diversify its training data, RoboCat not only shows signs of cross-task transfer, but also becomes more efficient at adapting to new tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RoboCat，一个多实体、多任务的通用机器人操作智能体。它基于视觉目标条件决策Transformer，能消费带动作标签的视觉经验（涵盖模拟和真实机器人手臂的各种观测与动作），可零样本或通过少量（100-1000个）示例适应新任务和新机器人。RoboCat还能利用自身生成数据用于后续训练迭代，形成自主改进循环。在模拟和三种不同真实机器人上的大规模评估表明，随着训练数据增长和多样化，RoboCat不仅表现出跨任务迁移能力，对新任务的适应效率也更高。
AI.motivation: 借鉴视觉和语言领域基础模型的进展，希望利用来自不同机器人和任务的异构机器人经验，快速掌握新技能和新实体，从而变革机器人学习范式，解决机器人学习中数据稀缺和泛化能力差的问题。
AI.method: RoboCat是一个视觉目标条件决策Transformer（visual goal-conditioned decision transformer），将跨实体、跨任务的带动作标签视觉经验作为训练数据，通过大规模多样化数据集训练一个通用智能体。它还利用训练后的模型自身生成数据（自生成数据）用于后续训练迭代，形成一个自主改进的构建模块。
AI.result: 在模拟环境和三种不同真实机器人实体上进行的大规模评估显示，RoboCat能够零样本泛化到新任务和新机器人，也能通过仅100-1000个示例快速适应新任务。随着训练数据的增长和多样化，RoboCat展现了跨任务迁移能力，并且自适应新任务的效率显著提升。
AI.conclusion: RoboCat验证了多实体、多任务通用操作智能体的可行性，其自主数据生成与迭代训练机制为构建可持续自我提升的机器人学习系统提供了基础。数据规模与多样性是提升迁移和适应能力的关键因素。

title: VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are shown to possess a wealth of actionable knowledge that can be extracted for robot manipulation in the form of reasoning and planning. Despite the progress, most still rely on pre-defined motion primitives to carry out the physical interactions with the environment, which remains a major bottleneck. In this work, we aim to synthesize robot trajectories, i.e., a dense sequence of 6-DoF end-effector waypoints, for a large variety of manipulation tasks given an open-set of instructions and an open-set of objects. We achieve this by first observing that LLMs excel at inferring affordances and constraints given a free-form language instruction. More importantly, by leveraging their code-writing capabilities, they can interact with a vision-language model (VLM) to compose 3D value maps to ground the knowledge into the observation space of the agent. The composed value maps are then used in a model-based planning framework to zero-shot synthesize closed-loop robot trajectories with robustness to dynamic perturbations. We further demonstrate how the proposed framework can benefit from online experiences by efficiently learning a dynamics model for scenes that involve contact-rich interactions. We present a large-scale study of the proposed method in both simulated and real-robot environments, showcasing the ability to perform a large variety of everyday manipulation tasks specified in free-form natural language. Videos and code at https://voxposer.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出VoxPoser框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）与视觉语言模型（VLM）的交互，通过代码编写能力将语言指令中的语义知识（affordance和constraints）组合成3D体素值图（voxel value maps），再结合基于模型的规划框架零样本合成6-DoF机械臂末端执行器的稠密轨迹，用于开放指令和开放物体的各类操作任务。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的机器人操作方法大多依赖预定义的运动原语（motion primitives）来执行物理交互，这成为机器人操作的主要瓶颈。作者旨在突破这一限制，让LLM不仅负责推理和规划，还能直接参与合成机器人运动的轨迹。
AI.method: 1) 利用LLM的代码编写能力，使其与VLM交互，将自由形式语言指令中的语义知识（如affordances和constraints）组合成3D价值图（voxel value maps），将知识扎根到智能体的观测空间；2) 将组合出的价值图用于基于模型的规划框架中，零样本合成闭环机器人轨迹，具备对动态扰动的鲁棒性；3) 通过在线经验高效学习动力学模型，以处理涉及接触丰富的交互场景。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实机器人环境中进行了大规模研究，展示了该方法能够执行各种以自由形式自然语言指定的日常操作任务，且能处理动态扰动并受益于在线经验学习。
AI.conclusion: 通过LLM与VLM的协作将语言知识映射为3D价值图并驱动模型规划，VoxPoser实现了无需预定义运动原语的零样本机器人轨迹合成，在开放指令和开放物体条件下具备良好的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
summary: We study how vision-language models trained on Internet-scale data can be incorporated directly into end-to-end robotic control to boost generalization and enable emergent semantic reasoning. Our goal is to enable a single end-to-end trained model to both learn to map robot observations to actions and enjoy the benefits of large-scale pretraining on language and vision-language data from the web. To this end, we propose to co-fine-tune state-of-the-art vision-language models on both robotic trajectory data and Internet-scale vision-language tasks, such as visual question answering. In contrast to other approaches, we propose a simple, general recipe to achieve this goal: in order to fit both natural language responses and robotic actions into the same format, we express the actions as text tokens and incorporate them directly into the training set of the model in the same way as natural language tokens. We refer to such category of models as vision-language-action models (VLA) and instantiate an example of such a model, which we call RT-2. Our extensive evaluation (6k evaluation trials) shows that our approach leads to performant robotic policies and enables RT-2 to obtain a range of emergent capabilities from Internet-scale training. This includes significantly improved generalization to novel objects, the ability to interpret commands not present in the robot training data (such as placing an object onto a particular number or icon), and the ability to perform rudimentary reasoning in response to user commands (such as picking up the smallest or largest object, or the one closest to another object). We further show that incorporating chain of thought reasoning allows RT-2 to perform multi-stage semantic reasoning, for example figuring out which object to pick up for use as an improvised hammer (a rock), or which type of drink is best suited for someone who is tired (an energy drink).

AI.tldr: 本文提出RT-2，一种视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），将大规模互联网预训练的视觉语言模型通过共同微调的方式，同时处理机器人轨迹数据和互联网规模的视觉语言任务。核心思想是将机器人动作表示为文本token，与自然语言token一起直接输入模型训练，从而实现端到端的机器人控制，并获得互联网规模训练带来的泛化能力和涌现语义推理能力。
AI.motivation: 传统的端到端机器人控制模型无法利用互联网规模数据的预训练优势，而大规模视觉语言模型虽具备强大的泛化和语义理解能力，却未被直接用于机器人控制。作者希望构建一个单一的端到端训练模型，既能学习从机器人观测到动作的映射，又能享受互联网规模预训练带来的好处。
AI.method: 提出视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的通用框架：将机器人动作编码为文本token，直接融入模型的训练集中，与自然语言token同等处理。具体实例化为RT-2模型，通过共同微调（co-fine-tune）最先进的视觉语言模型，同时在机器人轨迹数据和互联网规模的视觉语言任务（如视觉问答）上进行训练。
AI.result: 在6000次评估试验中，RT-2展示了多种涌现能力：对新颖物体的显著泛化能力提升；能够解释机器人训练数据中不存在的命令（如将物体放到特定数字或图标上）；能够执行基本的语义推理（如拿起最小/最大的物体）；通过链式思维（chain of thought）推理，还能进行多阶段语义推理（如判断用石头作为临时锤子，或为疲劳的人选择能量饮料）。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉语言模型与机器人控制统一为文本token格式是可行且有效的方案。互联网规模预训练使机器人策略获得超越机器人训练数据本身的泛化能力和涌现的语义推理能力，为机器人学习开辟了新范式。

title: Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models
summary: Large, high-capacity models trained on diverse datasets have shown remarkable successes on efficiently tackling downstream applications. In domains from NLP to Computer Vision, this has led to a consolidation of pretrained models, with general pretrained backbones serving as a starting point for many applications. Can such a consolidation happen in robotics? Conventionally, robotic learning methods train a separate model for every application, every robot, and even every environment. Can we instead train generalist X-robot policy that can be adapted efficiently to new robots, tasks, and environments? In this paper, we provide datasets in standardized data formats and models to make it possible to explore this possibility in the context of robotic manipulation, alongside experimental results that provide an example of effective X-robot policies. We assemble a dataset from 22 different robots collected through a collaboration between 21 institutions, demonstrating 527 skills (160266 tasks). We show that a high-capacity model trained on this data, which we call RT-X, exhibits positive transfer and improves the capabilities of multiple robots by leveraging experience from other platforms. More details can be found on the project website https://robotics-transformer-x.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文探索机器人领域的"基础模型"整合可能性，提出一个由22种不同机器人、21个机构合作收集的大规模跨机器人操作数据集（527项技能、160266个任务），并训练了名为RT-X的高容量跨机器人策略模型。实验表明RT-X展现出正向迁移能力，能利用其他平台的经验提升多个机器人平台的操作能力。
AI.motivation: 在NLP和计算机视觉领域，大规模预训练模型已成为各类下游任务的基础起点。作者质疑机器人学习是否也能实现类似的"整合"（consolidation）。传统机器人学习方法为每个应用、每个机器人、甚至每个环境分别训练独立模型，作者希望探索能否训练一个通用的跨机器人（X-robot）策略，使其能够高效地适应新的机器人、任务和环境。
AI.method: 作者通过与21个机构合作，从22种不同机器人上收集大规模操作数据，构建了标准化格式的数据集（涵盖527项技能、160266个任务）。基于该数据集训练了一个高容量模型RT-X，该模型采用跨平台数据联合训练的方式，以实现跨机器人的知识共享和迁移。
AI.result: 实验结果表明RT-X模型展现出正向迁移（positive transfer）现象，即在多个机器人平台上，利用来自其他平台的经验能够有效提升各机器人的操作能力。这证明了跨机器人数据联合训练在机器人操作领域的可行性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过大规模跨机构协作和标准化数据集构建，证明了机器人领域存在实现类似NLP/CV中"预训练基础模型"整合的可能性。RT-X作为示例性的X-robot跨机器人策略，展示了跨平台数据共享带来的性能增益，为机器人学习的通用化、规模化发展提供了新的方向和基础资源。

title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
summary: Large policies pretrained on diverse robot datasets have the potential to transform robotic learning: instead of training new policies from scratch, such generalist robot policies may be finetuned with only a little in-domain data, yet generalize broadly. However, to be widely applicable across a range of robotic learning scenarios, environments, and tasks, such policies need to handle diverse sensors and action spaces, accommodate a variety of commonly used robotic platforms, and finetune readily and efficiently to new domains. In this work, we aim to lay the groundwork for developing open-source, widely applicable, generalist policies for robotic manipulation. As a first step, we introduce Octo, a large transformer-based policy trained on 800k trajectories from the Open X-Embodiment dataset, the largest robot manipulation dataset to date. It can be instructed via language commands or goal images and can be effectively finetuned to robot setups with new sensory inputs and action spaces within a few hours on standard consumer GPUs. In experiments across 9 robotic platforms, we demonstrate that Octo serves as a versatile policy initialization that can be effectively finetuned to new observation and action spaces. We also perform detailed ablations of design decisions for the Octo model, from architecture to training data, to guide future research on building generalist robot models.

AI.tldr: Octo是一个基于Transformer的大型机器人操作策略，在Open X-Embodiment数据集的80万条轨迹上预训练，可通过语言命令或目标图像进行指令，并能在消费级GPU上数小时内微调适应新的传感器输入和动作空间。实验覆盖9个机器人平台，证明了其作为通用策略初始化的有效性。
AI.motivation: 大型预训练策略有潜力通过少量域内数据微调来泛化到广泛任务，避免从零训练。然而，要广泛应用于不同的机器人学习场景，策略需要处理多样的传感器、动作空间和机器人平台，并支持高效微调。作者希望为开发开源、广泛适用的通用机器人操作策略奠定基础。
AI.method: Octo是一个基于Transformer的大型策略模型，在Open X-Embodiment（最大的机器人操作数据集，80万条轨迹）上训练。模型支持语言命令或目标图像作为指令输入，可微调适应新的传感器输入和动作空间，且微调可在标准消费级GPU上数小时内完成。
AI.result: 在9个机器人平台上的实验表明，Octo可以作为一种多功能的策略初始化，能够有效微调到新的观测和动作空间。论文还进行了详细的消融实验（从架构到训练数据的设计决策），以指导未来通用机器人模型的研究。
AI.conclusion: Octo验证了大规模多机器人数据预训练策略的可行性，为构建开源、广泛适用的通用机器人操作策略奠定了基础，并提供了关键设计决策的分析以推动后续研究。

title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Large policies pretrained on a combination of Internet-scale vision-language data and diverse robot demonstrations have the potential to change how we teach robots new skills: rather than training new behaviors from scratch, we can fine-tune such vision-language-action (VLA) models to obtain robust, generalizable policies for visuomotor control. Yet, widespread adoption of VLAs for robotics has been challenging as 1) existing VLAs are largely closed and inaccessible to the public, and 2) prior work fails to explore methods for efficiently fine-tuning VLAs for new tasks, a key component for adoption. Addressing these challenges, we introduce OpenVLA, a 7B-parameter open-source VLA trained on a diverse collection of 970k real-world robot demonstrations. OpenVLA builds on a Llama 2 language model combined with a visual encoder that fuses pretrained features from DINOv2 and SigLIP. As a product of the added data diversity and new model components, OpenVLA demonstrates strong results for generalist manipulation, outperforming closed models such as RT-2-X (55B) by 16.5% in absolute task success rate across 29 tasks and multiple robot embodiments, with 7x fewer parameters. We further show that we can effectively fine-tune OpenVLA for new settings, with especially strong generalization results in multi-task environments involving multiple objects and strong language grounding abilities, and outperform expressive from-scratch imitation learning methods such as Diffusion Policy by 20.4%. We also explore compute efficiency; as a separate contribution, we show that OpenVLA can be fine-tuned on consumer GPUs via modern low-rank adaptation methods and served efficiently via quantization without a hit to downstream success rate. Finally, we release model checkpoints, fine-tuning notebooks, and our PyTorch codebase with built-in support for training VLAs at scale on Open X-Embodiment datasets.

AI.tldr: OpenVLA是一个7B参数的开源视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型，在970k真实机器人演示数据上训练，以Llama 2语言模型为基础，融合DINOv2和SigLIP视觉特征。它在29个任务、多种机器人平台上超越闭源模型RT-2-X(55B)达16.5%绝对成功率，同时参数量减少7倍；可通过低秩适配方法在消费级GPU上微调，且量化部署不影响成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型大多闭源且无法公开访问，同时缺乏对高效微调方法的探索，这两大障碍严重限制了VLA模型在机器人领域的广泛采用。作者希望通过发布开源模型并探索高效微调策略，推动VLA在机器人技能学习中的落地应用。
AI.method: OpenVLA采用Llama 2语言模型作为主干，结合一个融合DINOv2和SigLIP预训练特征的视觉编码器。模型在包含970k条来自Open X-Embodiment数据集的真实机器人演示上进行大规模训练。实验中还探索了低秩适配(LoRA)微调方法和量化推理技术以提升计算效率。
AI.result: 在29个任务和多种机器人本体上，OpenVLA以7倍更少的参数量在绝对任务成功率上超越RT-2-X(55B) 达16.5%；在多任务环境中比Diffusion Policy等从头训练的模仿学习方法高20.4%；在消费级GPU上可微调、量化后部署不影响成功率。
AI.conclusion: 开源VLA模型在通用操作任务上能够超越更大的闭源模型，并且通过LoRA微调和量化技术，可以在消费级硬件上高效适配新任务，为VLA在机器人领域的广泛采用提供了可行路径。作者开源了模型权重、微调教程和PyTorch代码库以促进社区研究。

title: RDT-1B: a Diffusion Foundation Model for Bimanual Manipulation
summary: Bimanual manipulation is essential in robotics, yet developing foundation models is extremely challenging due to the inherent complexity of coordinating two robot arms (leading to multi-modal action distributions) and the scarcity of training data. In this paper, we present the Robotics Diffusion Transformer (RDT), a pioneering diffusion foundation model for bimanual manipulation. RDT builds on diffusion models to effectively represent multi-modality, with innovative designs of a scalable Transformer to deal with the heterogeneity of multi-modal inputs and to capture the nonlinearity and high frequency of robotic data. To address data scarcity, we further introduce a Physically Interpretable Unified Action Space, which can unify the action representations of various robots while preserving the physical meanings of original actions, facilitating learning transferrable physical knowledge. With these designs, we managed to pre-train RDT on the largest collection of multi-robot datasets to date and scaled it up to 1.2B parameters, which is the largest diffusion-based foundation model for robotic manipulation. We finally fine-tuned RDT on a self-created multi-task bimanual dataset with over 6K+ episodes to refine its manipulation capabilities. Experiments on real robots demonstrate that RDT significantly outperforms existing methods. It exhibits zero-shot generalization to unseen objects and scenes, understands and follows language instructions, learns new skills with just 1~5 demonstrations, and effectively handles complex, dexterous tasks. We refer to https://rdt-robotics.github.io/rdt-robotics/ for the code and videos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RDT（Robotics Diffusion Transformer），一种面向双臂操作任务的扩散基础模型。RDT利用扩散模型建模双臂操作中的多模态动作分布，设计可扩展的Transformer处理多模态输入的异质性，并引入物理可解释统一动作空间来统一不同机器人的动作表征以缓解数据稀缺问题。RDT在迄今最大的多机器人数据集上预训练，参数量达12亿，是最大的基于扩散的机器人操作基础模型。在自建的多任务双臂数据集（6000+条演示）上微调后，RDT在真实机器人上显著优于现有方法，展现出对新物体和新场景的零样本泛化能力、理解和遵循语言指令的能力、仅需1~5次演示即可学习新技能的能力，以及处理复杂灵巧任务的能力。
AI.motivation: 双臂操作在机器人领域至关重要，但开发基础模型极具挑战，主要面临两大难题：一是协调两个机械臂导致多模态动作分布，难以用传统方法建模；二是训练数据极度稀缺。现有方法难以同时解决这两个问题，因此需要一个既能有效表示多模态动作分布又能应对数据稀缺的模型架构。
AI.method: RDT包含三项核心设计：(1) 基于扩散模型有效表示双臂操作中的多模态动作分布；(2) 采用可扩展的Transformer架构处理多模态输入的异质性，并捕捉机器人数据的非线性和高频特征；(3) 提出物理可解释统一动作空间（Physically Interpretable Unified Action Space），在统一不同机器人动作表征的同时保留原始动作的物理含义，促进可迁移的物理知识学习。模型在最大规模多机器人数据集上预训练（12亿参数），随后在自建的双臂多任务数据集上微调。
AI.result: 在真实机器人实验中，RDT显著优于现有方法。具体表现为：对新物体和新场景具有零样本泛化能力；能够理解和遵循语言指令；仅需1~5次演示即可学习新技能；能有效处理复杂灵巧任务。RDT是迄今最大的基于扩散的机器人操作基础模型（12亿参数）。
AI.conclusion: RDT验证了扩散基础模型在双臂操作领域的可行性，通过扩散模型表示多模态、Transformer处理异质性输入、统一动作空间缓解数据稀缺等设计，成功构建了可扩展的基础模型。实验证明其在泛化能力、语言指令理解、少样本学习和灵巧操作方面均取得显著突破，为机器人操作基础模型的发展提供了新的方向。

title: $π_0$: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
summary: Robot learning holds tremendous promise to unlock the full potential of flexible, general, and dexterous robot systems, as well as to address some of the deepest questions in artificial intelligence. However, bringing robot learning to the level of generality required for effective real-world systems faces major obstacles in terms of data, generalization, and robustness. In this paper, we discuss how generalist robot policies (i.e., robot foundation models) can address these challenges, and how we can design effective generalist robot policies for complex and highly dexterous tasks. We propose a novel flow matching architecture built on top of a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) to inherit Internet-scale semantic knowledge. We then discuss how this model can be trained on a large and diverse dataset from multiple dexterous robot platforms, including single-arm robots, dual-arm robots, and mobile manipulators. We evaluate our model in terms of its ability to perform tasks in zero shot after pre-training, follow language instructions from people and from a high-level VLM policy, and its ability to acquire new skills via fine-tuning. Our results cover a wide variety of tasks, such as laundry folding, table cleaning, and assembling boxes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）的流匹配（flow matching）架构，用于构建通用机器人策略（机器人基础模型）。该模型在来自多种灵巧机器人平台（单臂、双臂、移动操作器）的大规模异构数据集上训练，具备零样本泛化、语言指令跟随以及微调获取新技能的能力，并在衣物折叠、桌面清洁、盒子组装等任务上取得了良好效果。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习在数据、泛化和鲁棒性方面面临重大障碍，难以达到真实世界应用所需的通用性水平。本文旨在通过通用机器人策略（即机器人基础模型）来解决这些挑战，实现灵活、通用且在复杂灵巧任务中有效的机器人系统。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的流匹配（flow matching）架构，构建在预训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）之上，以继承互联网规模的语义知识。模型在大规模且多样的灵巧机器人平台数据集（包括单臂机器人、双臂机器人和移动操作器）上进行训练。
AI.result: 模型在预训练后能够在零样本条件下执行任务，能够遵循来自人类和高层VLM策略的语言指令，并能通过微调获取新技能。在衣物折叠、桌面清理、盒子组装等多种任务上取得了覆盖广泛的实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 利用预训练VLM与流匹配架构相结合的方法，可以有效构建通用机器人策略，解决机器人学习中数据、泛化和鲁棒性的核心挑战，为复杂灵巧操作任务提供可行路径。

title: Gemini Robotics: Bringing AI into the Physical World
summary: Recent advancements in large multimodal models have led to the emergence of remarkable generalist capabilities in digital domains, yet their translation to physical agents such as robots remains a significant challenge. This report introduces a new family of AI models purposefully designed for robotics and built upon the foundation of Gemini 2.0. We present Gemini Robotics, an advanced Vision-Language-Action (VLA) generalist model capable of directly controlling robots. Gemini Robotics executes smooth and reactive movements to tackle a wide range of complex manipulation tasks while also being robust to variations in object types and positions, handling unseen environments as well as following diverse, open vocabulary instructions. We show that with additional fine-tuning, Gemini Robotics can be specialized to new capabilities including solving long-horizon, highly dexterous tasks, learning new short-horizon tasks from as few as 100 demonstrations and adapting to completely novel robot embodiments. This is made possible because Gemini Robotics builds on top of the Gemini Robotics-ER model, the second model we introduce in this work. Gemini Robotics-ER (Embodied Reasoning) extends Gemini's multimodal reasoning capabilities into the physical world, with enhanced spatial and temporal understanding. This enables capabilities relevant to robotics including object detection, pointing, trajectory and grasp prediction, as well as multi-view correspondence and 3D bounding box predictions. We show how this novel combination can support a variety of robotics applications. We also discuss and address important safety considerations related to this new class of robotics foundation models. The Gemini Robotics family marks a substantial step towards developing general-purpose robots that realizes AI's potential in the physical world.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个专为机器人设计的新一代AI模型家族Gemini Robotics，该家族基于Gemini 2.0构建，包含一个可直接控制机器人的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）通用模型Gemini Robotics，以及一个增强具身推理能力的Gemini Robotics-ER模型。通过微调，该模型可适应新的机器人形态、完成长时程高灵巧任务，并具备安全考虑。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型在数字领域展现出强大的通用能力，但将其迁移到物理智能体（如机器人）仍然是一个重大挑战。作者旨在弥合这一差距，将先进的多模态推理能力延伸到真实世界的机器人控制中。
AI.method: 以Gemini 2.0为基础构建一个新的AI模型家族。包含两个核心模型：(1) Gemini Robotics——一个VLA通用模型，可直接实现平滑、反应式的机器人控制，对物体类型和位置的变异具有鲁棒性，能处理未见环境并遵循多样化的开放词汇指令；(2) Gemini Robotics-ER（具身推理模型）——扩展了Gemini的多模态推理能力到物理世界，增强空间和时间理解，支持物体检测、指认、轨迹和抓取预测、多视图对应以及3D边界框预测。通过额外微调，模型可专门化以解决长时程高灵巧任务、从少量演示中学习新任务并适应全新的机器人形态。
AI.result: Gemini Robotics能够处理广泛的复杂操作任务，对物体类型和位置变化具有鲁棒性，能适应未见环境和开放词汇指令。通过微调可掌握长时程高灵巧任务、从低至100个演示中学习新短时程任务、并适应完全新颖的机器人形态。Gemini Robotics-ER展示了包括物体检测、指认、轨迹和抓取预测、多视图对应及3D边界框预测等能力，支持多种机器人应用。
AI.conclusion: Gemini Robotics家族代表了通用机器人发展的重要一步，标志着AI在物理世界中实现其潜力的实质性进展。本文还讨论了针对这类新机器人基础模型的重要安全考量。
